quotes.overview: Autoresearch is the practice of turning experimental research into an agent-run optimization loop: an AI coding agent proposes a change, edits an executable research artifact, runs a bounded experiment, reads the metric, keeps or reverts the change, and repeats until the search budget is exhausted.
quotes.karpathy: karpathy/autoresearch gives the agent a compact LLM training setup, lets it edit train.py, runs fixed 5-minute training experiments, evaluates val_bpb
quotes.working_definition: autoresearch means an autonomous, metric-driven, code-editing research loop with five components: a bounded experimental sandbox, an editable artifact, a proposer agent, an evaluator, and a durable memory of attempts.
quotes.meta_harness_fit: Meta-Harness is the natural generalization of autoresearch from “optimize a training file” to “optimize the harness around an LLM system.”
quotes.harness_def: A harness is the executable environment wrapped around a fixed model. ... The harness is therefore a policy over context and control flow.
